findings.evidenceJa: 桜、セイバーに悪かったって言ってた
findings.governingReading: Sakura said that she had wronged Saber or felt bad about it
findings.explanation: A report of Sakura’s words and judgment becomes an act of apologizing.

findings.evidenceJa: 私の不徳
findings.governingReading: Saber’s own lack of virtue or proper conduct
findings.explanation: Saber’s broad moral self-reproach is narrowed to thoughtlessness.

findings.evidenceJa: ぶつぶつと考え込んでいる
findings.governingReading: Saber is muttering to herself while absorbed in thought
findings.explanation: The audible comic sign of Saber’s rumination disappears.

findings.highlight: she’s pondering so much that she’s eating at incredible speed
findings.evidenceJa: 考え込みながらご飯を食べるもんだから箸が進むこと進むこと
findings.governingReading: even while brooding she keeps eating, so her chopsticks move and move
findings.explanation: mirror moon makes intense thinking cause fast eating, replacing the joke that her appetite proceeds undisturbed.

findings.highlight: If it’s not a big deal
findings.evidenceJa: なんでもないんなら
findings.governingReading: if nothing happened or nothing is wrong
findings.explanation: Absence of an incident becomes merely low importance.

findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜から同じ事を言う
findings.governingReading: have been saying the same thing since last night
findings.explanation: The duration connecting Sakura’s and Shirou’s repeated concern is omitted.

findings.highlight: you two are playing a prank on me
findings.evidenceJa: 二人そろって、私をからかっている
findings.governingReading: the two of them together may be teasing Saber
findings.explanation: Light coordinated teasing becomes a constructed prank.

findings.evidenceJa: 卵焼きを口に運ぶ
findings.governingReading: brings a piece of rolled omelet to her mouth
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the dish, adds another serving, and replaces a single bite with vigorous eating.

findings.highlight: I did not have the skill
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントとしての力不足
findings.governingReading: her insufficiency in power or capacity as a Servant
findings.explanation: A broad shortfall in Servant capability becomes lack of technical skill.

findings.highlight: You’re doing more than I can ask
findings.evidenceJa: 十分すぎるぐらいやってくれてる
findings.governingReading: Saber has already done more than enough
findings.explanation: Shirou’s assessment of sufficiency becomes a comparison with what he requested.

findings.highlight: I will continue taking you into battle
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方というマスターを、これからも戦いに赴かせる
findings.governingReading: she will continue sending Shirou, her Master, into battle
findings.explanation: The Master role central to Saber’s unresolved duty conflict disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 食事中、気まぐれにつけたテレビ
findings.governingReading: the television he idly turned on during breakfast
findings.explanation: The incidental mealtime context explaining how the report enters the scene disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 三十名におよび
findings.governingReading: the people found ill number thirty
findings.explanation: mirror moon increases the reported victim count beyond thirty.

findings.evidenceJa: 深山南四丁目
findings.governingReading: Miyama South, fourth chome or district
findings.explanation: A Japanese address district is mistranslated as an avenue.

findings.evidenceJa: 何らかの薬物が散布された可能性
findings.governingReading: the possibility that some drug or chemical substance was dispersed
findings.explanation: Possible deliberate or airborne dispersal becomes a spreading spill.

findings.highlight: the direction Tohsaka was staring at yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜、遠坂が睨みつけていた方角
findings.governingReading: the direction Rin glared toward last night
findings.explanation: The precise nighttime observation and intensity of Rin’s gaze are weakened.

findings.highlight: I’ve experienced what they’re going through firsthand
findings.evidenceJa: その昏睡がどのようなモノなのか、俺は自分の体で味わった
findings.governingReading: Shirou has tasted in his own body what that kind of coma is like
findings.explanation: A limited analogy from Shirou’s bodily experience becomes certainty that he underwent what the current victims are undergoing.

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターは丁寧だった
findings.governingReading: Caster’s extraction was comparatively careful or controlled
findings.explanation: Technical care preserving repeatable victims becomes personal gentleness and consideration.

findings.highlight: so that she could continue to drain them
findings.evidenceJa: 何度でも繰り返し魔力を得られるよう巧妙に手を尽くしていた
findings.governingReading: she used elaborate measures so she could extract magical energy from the same people repeatedly
findings.explanation: The designed repeatability and ingenuity of Caster’s method are generalized.

findings.highlight: That thing was not collecting blood like Caster
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの採血に比べれば
findings.governingReading: compared with Caster’s figurative blood draw
findings.explanation: mirror moon treats the syringe analogy as though Caster literally collected blood.

findings.evidenceJa: 何の容赦も考えもなく
findings.governingReading: without mercy or any consideration at all
findings.explanation: The shadow’s lack of thought or discrimination disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 静かに続きを促してくれた
findings.governingReading: Saber quietly prompts him to continue
findings.explanation: A receptive invitation to explain becomes interrogation.

findings.highlight: not resembling any of the fantasy race
findings.evidenceJa: どのような幻想種にも該当しない
findings.governingReading: corresponding to no known kind of Phantasmal Species
findings.explanation: The Fate-specific category is rendered as malformed singular “fantasy race.”

findings.evidenceJa: 意図的に俺や遠坂を狙ってきた
findings.governingReading: it deliberately targeted Shirou and Rin
findings.explanation: The evidence that the shadow selected them intentionally disappears.

findings.highlight: We are to fight something that is neither a Master nor a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: 私たちには関わりのないモノの相手をすると
findings.governingReading: take on something outside their own involvement, neither Master nor Servant
findings.explanation: Saber’s objection that the entity lies outside their immediate conflict disappears.

findings.highlight: I can’t bear it any longer
findings.evidenceJa: 息が続かなくなった
findings.governingReading: the extreme silence leaves Shirou unable to keep holding his breath or speaking
findings.explanation: A bodily and conversational failure under Saber’s stare becomes generic emotional intolerance.

findings.highlight: I will be putting the cart before the horse
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方を守りきれねば本末転倒です
findings.governingReading: if she then fails to protect him, the result defeats the entire purpose
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns the idiomatic reversal directly to Saber as an action rather than to the failed protective outcome.

findings.evidenceJa: この時代に留まれません
findings.governingReading: remain in this era, with era read as world
findings.explanation: The written era and spoken world layers collapse into generic world, losing Saber’s temporal displacement.

findings.highlight: I can only obey, even if I am against your proposal
findings.evidenceJa: シロウの方針に従うしかない
findings.governingReading: she has no choice but to follow Shirou’s chosen policy despite opposing it
findings.explanation: A continuing operational policy becomes obedience to a single proposal.

findings.highlight: how many more times you will be reckless
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜のような無茶をいつしでかすか
findings.governingReading: when he might again do something reckless like last night
findings.explanation: The specific precedent and unpredictability of recurrence disappear.

findings.highlight: I will lend you my sword
findings.evidenceJa: 剣は預けます
findings.governingReading: she entrusts her sword to him
findings.explanation: Saber’s commitment of her service and trust is weakened into a temporary loan.

findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーとて御しやすい相手
findings.governingReading: even Berserker would be easier to handle or control
findings.explanation: Broad manageability is narrowed to combat difficulty.

findings.evidenceJa: 肌で感じた
findings.governingReading: he felt that directly on his own skin
findings.explanation: Shirou’s embodied certainty about the shadow’s nature disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 胸に刻んでおいてください
findings.governingReading: engrave that warning in his heart or breast from this moment
findings.explanation: Saber’s forceful bodily metaphor for permanent remembrance becomes a routine reminder.

findings.evidenceJa: あの影が何者なのかは判らない
findings.governingReading: she does not know what the shadow is
findings.explanation: Specific ignorance of identity becomes total ignorance.

findings.highlight: As if to express her ominous premonition
findings.evidenceJa: 暗い予知を吐露するように
findings.governingReading: she speaks as though confessing a dark premonition
findings.explanation: The manner framing Saber’s speech is displaced after the quotation and weakened into a retrospective gloss.

findings.evidenceJa: 関わったもの全てに破滅をもたらす
findings.governingReading: brings ruin to everyone and everything that becomes involved with it
findings.explanation: The curse’s relational scope is replaced by universal physical destruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 呪い
findings.governingReading: curse, read as thorns
findings.explanation: The thorn reading embedded in Saber’s curse image disappears.
